taskTitle: Where ten HTTP header fields are defined

checks.detail: 3 proposers ran in parallel, one per lens
4 phases had the tools designed for them

finalText:
All 10 fields are defined in four current RFCs:

- **RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics)** says it "obsoletes RFCs 2818, 7231, 7232, 7233, 7235, 7538, 7615, 7694, and portions of 7230" (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html). It defines Last-Modified, ETag, Location, Retry-After and Vary.
- **RFC 9111 (HTTP Caching)** says "This document obsoletes RFC 7234" (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html). It defines Age, Cache-Control and Expires.
- **RFC 8288 (Web Linking)** has the header line "Obsoletes: 5988" (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288.html). It defines Link.
- **RFC 6797 (HSTS)** defines Strict-Transport-Security (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6797.html).

**One check isn't finished:** I couldn't confirm from an official status page that RFC 6797 and RFC 8288 have never been obsoleted. The RFC Editor /info pages and the IANA field registry returned 404 errors. Searches for a newer RFC replacing either one found nothing, so treat those two as very likely current but not confirmed.

| Field | RFC | Section |
|---|---|---|
| Age | 9111 | 5.1 |
| Cache-Control | 9111 | 5.2 |
| Expires | 9111 | 5.3 |
| Last-Modified | 9110 | 8.8.2 |
| ETag | 9110 | 8.8.3 |
| Location | 9110 | 10.2.2 |
| Retry-After | 9110 | 10.2.3 |
| Vary | 9110 | 12.5.5 |
| Strict-Transport-Security | 6797 | 6.1 |
| Link | 8288 | 3 |

Each quote is the definition sentence at the start of its section. On the RFC pages these sentences wrap across lines; the quotes join those lines with single spaces, so an exact-spacing check might flag them.

{"field":"Last-Modified","rfc":"9110","section":"8.8.2","quote":"The \"Last-Modified\" header field in a response provides a timestamp indicating the date and time at which the origin server believes the selected representation was last modified, as determined at the conclusion of handling the request.","url":"https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html"},
{"field":"ETag","rfc":"9110","section":"8.8.3","quote":"The \"ETag\" field in a response provides the current entity tag for the selected representation, as determined at the conclusion of handling the request.","url":"https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html"},
